title: Grilled Lentil Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional tacos, featuring grilled lentils and a blend of Mexican spices.
instructions: Soak the lentils in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the lentils, then place them in a bowl.
Mix the Saudi Arabian aromatic spice blend and Arabian grill seasoning with the lentils.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Add the lentil mixture to the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing the grilled lentils into the shells.
Squeeze lime juice over the lentils and top with diced avocado if desired.
